Where the life-size Gundam statue stands, a huge Gundam event is being held!
It has giant dioramas beyond anything seen before,
interactive simulations built on cutting-edge tech,
and many exhibits opening up a new Gundam world.
And the main attraction of the event is...
Skilled Gundam gamers, famous Gunpla modelers,
and players picked by lottery from a crowd of entrants gather together,
enter the diorama battlefield with Gunpla they built themselves, and team up
to take on the greatest foe in the Gundam world: the Gundam...
The latest in Gunpla virtual battle simulation:
Gundam Breaker, outside the Battle Space
Every match is shown live on giant screens at the venue
and streamed online across the whole country.
The dazzling play of the chosen players
creates endless new great scenes in a Gundam world no one has seen yet,
and all Japan goes wild for these battles!
Now, lucky player who won a place against fierce competition!
Jump into the battlefield and show us how you fight!
The battle game and the main menu
A workshop for your Gunpla. Turn Runners won in battle into parts,
and rebuild or paint your Gunpla.
You sit at a battle terminal and put on the game's own HMD.
Scan data of your Gunpla is placed in the diorama's hangar,
and your view switches to inside the VR Hangar.
In the VR Hangar you see things as if shrunk down to scale.
Move around the hangar as your Normal Suit avatar
and look at your own and other players' Gunpla as giant mobile suits.
or "VR Hangar (Multi)" to play with other players.
You can still go to the Customize screen after entering the VR Hangar,
so to start playing right away, just pick the VR Hangar you want.
